To install gliff on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add gliff. It is a 6.5 MB download (16.4 MB installed), version 0.4.0-1, licensed MIT, BSD-2-Clause. Hyprland remote desktop over SSH (GPU H.264, 4:4:4). Check the project site for current pricing.

Install gliff on Omarchy

Hyprland remote desktop over SSH (GPU H.264, 4:4:4)

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add gliff
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.4.0-1:
    pacman -Qi gliff

Open and use gliff

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql gliff

Frequently asked questions

How do I install gliff on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add gliff. The download is 6.5 MB and it takes 16.4 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is gliff free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT, BSD-2-Clause.

How do I uninstall gliff?

Run omarchy pkg drop gliff. It removes the package from your system.

What does gliff depend on?

The package declares 13 dependencies: dbus, gcc-libs, glibc, gtk4, hicolor-icon-theme, libadwaita, libdrm, libva, libxkbcommon, mesa, openssh, vulkan-icd-loader and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is gliff in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as gliff (version 0.4.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://github.com/omacom/gliff. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
